title: The Porcelain Centipede Parade
description: On kiln-opening day, the potters glaze every segment of their parade centipede. A child slips it a petal as it takes its first steps.
alt: A child offers a pink petal to a huge blue-and-white porcelain centipede winding through a sunlit courtyard lined with spectators.
pairing: Kiln-opening day × a living porcelain centipede
